problem: The existing Select JSON contains incorrect rookie booleans, so its rookie=true field cannot be trusted directly by Team Hunt.

knownExample.reason: Established NFL veteran, not a 2024 rookie.

rules: Never use select.json rookie=true by itself to classify a player as a 2024 rookie.

A Select card may surface as Rookie in 2024 Team Hunt only when the player appears in CardStorm's verified 2024 rookie registry or a verified Select checklist explicitly identifies the card as a rookie.
Cards 501-520 are XRC redemptions and always have teamHuntEligible2024=false.
Established veterans and legends may remain valid 2024 Select cards, but rookie=false.
When rookie status is unresolved, classify the card as Base/Core with rookieStatus=unverified rather than guessing.
Team Hunt should prefer verified chase data over unvalidated Select base-card rookie flags.
